en.Situation: For my final-year project I classified student feedback comments into four themes with only 900 labelled rows.
en.Task: My goal was an honest evaluation, not the highest score I could report.
en.Action: I set a majority-class baseline, used five-fold cross validation, and wrote the confusion matrix per theme in the report.
en.Result: My model beat the baseline on three themes and tied on one, and the report said so.
en.vague: The project was about classifying comments and it went okay.
en.exaggerated: I achieved near-perfect accuracy that no one had reached before.
en.no_data: The model did better than the baseline and the report was accepted.

zh.Situation: 畢業專題我用 900 行標註數據，把學生評語分成四類。
zh.Task: 我嘅目標係誠實評估，而唔係報告最好睇嘅分數。
zh.Action: 我設 majority-class baseline，用五折交叉驗證，報告每個類別嘅 confusion matrix。
zh.Result: 模型喺三類贏 baseline，一類打成平手，報告就係咁寫。
zh.vague: 個專題係分類評語，做得還可以。
zh.exaggerated: 我做到前所未有嘅接近完美準確率。
zh.no_data: 模型好過 baseline，報告都收貨。

en.Situation: At a subscription company, the churn model was retrained every quarter but nobody watched it between retrains.
en.Task: I proposed a simple monitoring check, and I had to keep it small enough to run on our existing job.
en.Action: I logged weekly score distribution and input null rates, set a threshold on the mean score shift, and wrote one page on what to do when it fires.
en.Result: The check fired once in four months during a pricing change, and we retrained two weeks earlier than planned.
en.vague: We had a churn model and it was checked occasionally.
en.exaggerated: I built a full MLOps platform for the company by myself.
en.no_data: The monitoring gave us an early warning once.

zh.Situation: 喺一間訂閱制公司，churn model 每季重訓，但兩次重訓之間冇人睇。
zh.Task: 我提出一個簡單監控，但要好細，可以喺現有 job 上跑。
zh.Action: 我每星期記錄分數分佈同輸入 null 比率，為平均分變動設門檻，再寫一頁講觸發時點做。
zh.Result: 四個月內一次定價改動期間觸發咗，我哋提早兩星期重訓。
zh.vague: 我哋有個 churn model，偶爾會睇下。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人為公司建立咗完整 MLOps 平台。
zh.no_data: 監控有一次幫我哋提早發現問題。

en.Situation: At a support team, I was asked to auto-tag incoming tickets, but the existing labels had been applied by five people with no guide.
en.Task: I had to fix the labels before modelling, and explain to the team why the first model looked weaker after that.
en.Action: I sampled fifty tickets per label, wrote a one-page labelling guide with examples, and had two colleagues relabel a shared set.
en.Result: Agreement between the two colleagues was 0.71 on the shared set, and the model trained on the cleaner labels was easier to explain.
en.vague: The ticket labels were inconsistent and it made modelling hard.
en.exaggerated: I solved the company's entire support automation problem.
en.no_data: After relabelling, the model was more consistent.

zh.Situation: 喺 support 團隊，有人叫我自動為 ticket 加標籤，但現有標籤係五個人冇指南咁加上去。
zh.Task: 我要先修好標籤才建模，並向團隊解釋點解第一個模型修完之後睇落更差。
zh.Action: 我每個標籤抽五十張 ticket，寫一頁有例子嘅標註指南，再請兩位同事重標同一批。
zh.Result: 兩位同事喺共用樣本上一致度係 0.71，用乾淨標籤訓練嘅模型亦容易解釋啲。
zh.vague: ticket 標籤唔一致，令建模好難。
zh.exaggerated: 我解決咗公司成個客服自動化問題。

en.Situation: Four years in, our recommendation endpoint took 900 milliseconds at peak and the app hid the section on slow networks.
en.Task: I had to cut the response time, and I wanted to change the serving path without retraining the model.
en.Action: I precomputed neighbours nightly, cached the top fifty per user, and kept a live fallback for new users.
en.Result: The p95 came down to 120 milliseconds, and the app stopped hiding the section.
en.vague: The recommendation endpoint was slow at peak hours.
en.exaggerated: I made the recommendation system the fastest in the market.
en.no_data: Response time improved and the section stayed visible.

zh.Situation: 做咗四年，推薦 endpoint 高峯時要 900 毫秒，app 喺慢網絡會索性收起個區塊。
zh.Task: 我要減低回應時間，並希望改 serving 路徑而唔重訓模型。
zh.Action: 我每晚預算鄰居，為每個用戶 cache 頭五十個，並為新用戶保留即時計算 fallback。
zh.Result: p95 跌到 120 毫秒，app 唔再收起個區塊。
zh.vague: 推薦 endpoint 高峯時好慢。
zh.exaggerated: 我令推薦系統成為市場最快。
zh.no_data: 回應時間改善，區塊保持顯示。

en.Situation: In my internship, I was asked to improve a course recommender and the team only measured click-through.
en.Task: I needed a baseline first, and I had to be careful not to claim an improvement the data could not support.
en.Action: I rebuilt the popularity baseline, added a simple content-based model, and compared both on a time-based holdout.
en.Result: The content model was better on recall at ten but worse on coverage, and I reported both.
en.vague: I worked on a recommender and tried a few models.
en.exaggerated: My model doubled the engagement of the platform.
en.no_data: The new model looked better on some measures and I reported that.

zh.Situation: 實習時有人叫我改善課程推薦，而團隊只量度點擊率。
zh.Task: 我要先有 baseline，同時唔可以聲稱數據支持唔到嘅改善。
zh.Action: 我重做 popularity baseline，加一個簡單 content-based 模型，再喺按時間切分嘅 holdout 上比較。
zh.Result: content 模型喺 recall@10 好啲但 coverage 差啲，我兩個都報。
zh.vague: 我做推薦，試咗幾個模型。
zh.exaggerated: 我個模型令平台互動翻倍。
zh.no_data: 新模型喺部分指標好啲，我就照咁報。

en.Situation: At a startup, the model was correct in notebooks but the API returned wrong labels for about one request in a hundred.
en.Task: I owned the serving API, and I had to find the difference between the notebook and production.
en.Action: I logged the raw payload for every request, found the client sent numbers as strings, and added validation with a clear 422 response.
en.Result: Wrong labels stopped, and the client fixed their serialisation after seeing our error message.
en.vague: The API returned some wrong results and we investigated.
en.exaggerated: I rewrote the whole inference service from scratch.
en.no_data: After the change the wrong labels stopped.

zh.Situation: 喺 startup，模型喺 notebook 好準，但 API 每百個 request 有一個標籤錯。
zh.Task: 我負責 serving API，要找出 notebook 同 production 嘅差異。
zh.Action: 我記錄每個 request 嘅原始 payload，發現客戶把數字當字串送，於是加驗證並回傳清楚嘅 422。
zh.Result: 錯標籤停止，客戶睇到我哋嘅錯誤訊息之後修正咗序列化。
zh.vague: API 有啲結果唔對，我哋去查。
zh.exaggerated: 我由零重寫咗成個 inference service。

en.Situation: At a bank, the risk team would not approve a credit model they could not explain to a regulator.
en.Task: I had to trade a little accuracy for explanation, and say clearly what we were giving up.
en.Action: I compared a gradient boosting model with a simpler scoring model, then produced per-feature contributions for the top denials.
en.Result: The simpler model lost two points of AUC but passed review, and the denial letters had a defensible reason each.
en.vague: There was a model approval discussion with the risk team.
en.exaggerated: I got a credit model approved by a regulator myself.
en.no_data: The simpler model was approved and the letters were clearer.

zh.Situation: 喺銀行，風險團隊唔會批一個解釋唔到畀監管機構嘅信貸模型。
zh.Task: 我要用少少準確度換解釋能力，並清楚講出我哋放棄咗咩。
zh.Action: 我比較 gradient boosting 同簡單評分模型，再為主要拒絕個案計每個特徵嘅貢獻。
zh.Result: 簡單模型 AUC 低兩點但過到審核，拒絕信每封都有站得住腳嘅理由。
zh.vague: 同風險團隊有一次模型批核討論。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人令監管機構批咗個信貸模型。
zh.no_data: 簡單模型獲批，拒絕信清楚咗。

en.Situation: On a six-month contract, I joined a labelling effort where four part-timers tagged 6,000 images with no shared examples.
en.Task: I was asked to raise consistency, without becoming the person who relabelled everything alone.
en.Action: I built a twenty-image reference sheet with edge cases, ran a short calibration round, and kept a shared log of disagreements.
en.Result: Disagreement dropped from about one in four images to one in nine over three weeks.
en.vague: The labelling work was inconsistent between people.
en.exaggerated: I fixed the labelling quality of the whole project by myself.
en.no_data: After the calibration, people labelled more consistently.

zh.Situation: 做半年合約，我加入一個標註項目，四個兼職同事標 6,000 張圖但冇共用例子。
zh.Task: 我要提高一致性，但唔想變成自己一個人重標所有嘢。
zh.Action: 我做咗一張廿張圖嘅參考表，包含邊界個案，做一次短校準，再開共用 log 記低分歧。
zh.Result: 三星期內分歧由大約四張有一張，跌到九張有一張。
zh.vague: 標註工作各人做法唔一致。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人修好咗整個項目嘅標註質量。
zh.no_data: 校準之後大家標得一致啲。

en.Situation: Two of us trained models in the same repo and our numbers never matched, even with the same data.
en.Task: I took on the comparison problem, and I wanted runs I could defend to my teammate.
en.Action: I fixed one split and seed, logged every hyperparameter, and wrote a small script that reruns both configs and prints a table.
en.Result: One teammate's run had been leaking the target through an id column, and after the fix the gap was under one point.
en.vague: Our experiment results did not match and it was confusing.
en.exaggerated: I designed the team's whole experiment process.
en.no_data: After fixing the setup, our results were close.

zh.Situation: 我同另一位同事喺同一個 repo 訓練模型，就算數據一樣，數字都對唔上。
zh.Task: 我接手處理比較問題，想要啲可以向同事解釋嘅 run。
zh.Action: 我固定同一個 split 同 seed，記錄每個 hyperparameter，寫個細 script 重跑兩套 config 並印表。
zh.Result: 發現同事個 run 透過 id 欄位漏咗 target 資訊，修好之後差距少過一個百分點。
zh.vague: 我哋實驗結果對唔上，好混亂。
zh.exaggerated: 我設計咗團隊成個實驗流程。
zh.no_data: 修好設定之後，結果接近咗。

en.Situation: Five years in at a retailer, the demand model degraded after a promotion calendar changed, and the planners lost confidence in it.
en.Task: I had to decide whether to retrain, reframe, or switch the planners back to their old sheet.
en.Action: I compared error by week, found the promotion features were flat during the new calendar, and added a promotion-type feature with two weeks of backtesting.
en.Result: Weekly error came back inside the old range, and the planners used the forecast again from the next cycle.
en.vague: The forecast became less accurate after some changes.
en.exaggerated: I saved the entire forecasting function of the business.
en.no_data: After the retrain the forecast error was acceptable again.

zh.Situation: 喺零售做咗五年，推廣日曆一改，需求模型就變差，規劃同事開始唔信佢。
zh.Task: 我要決定係重訓、改框架，定係叫同事用返舊 spreadsheet。
zh.Action: 我按星期比較誤差，發現推廣特徵喺新日曆下變成常數，於是加 promotion type 特徵並做兩星期回測。
zh.Result: 每週誤差返到舊範圍，規劃同事下個循環再用返個 forecast。
zh.vague: 改咗啲嘢之後 forecast 冇咁準。
zh.exaggerated: 我救返成間公司嘅預測部門。
zh.no_data: 重訓之後誤差返到可接受水平。

en.Situation: In my first job, a fraud model scored 0.99 in offline evaluation and much lower in the pilot.
en.Task: I was asked to explain the gap before we spent more weeks on tuning.
en.Action: I checked the feature list, found a settlement flag that is written after a case is confirmed, and removed it from the training set.
en.Result: Offline AUC fell to a realistic 0.78, and the pilot numbers then matched the offline ones.
en.vague: The model did not perform as expected in the pilot.
en.exaggerated: I discovered a fraud ring through my analysis.
en.no_data: After removing the feature, offline and pilot results were similar.

zh.Situation: 第一份工，個 fraud 模型離線評估 0.99，落到 pilot 就低好多。
zh.Task: 我要喺再花幾個星期調參之前，解釋呢個差距。
zh.Action: 我逐個特徵檢查，發現有個 settlement flag 係案件確認後才寫入，於是喺訓練集剔除。
zh.Result: 離線 AUC 跌到現實嘅 0.78，pilot 數字同離線之後就對得上。
zh.vague: 模型喺 pilot 表現唔如預期。
zh.exaggerated: 我透過分析發現咗一個詐騙集團。
zh.no_data: 剔除特徵之後，離線同 pilot 結果接近。

en.Situation: Working for a government-adjacent body, I built a text classifier to triage public enquiries and was asked to write its limitations.
en.Task: I had to describe honestly what the model could not do, in language a non-technical reader could act on.
en.Action: I tested it on enquiries from the previous year, recorded the error rate per topic, and wrote a limitations section naming two topics we excluded.
en.Result: The report listed two topics as out of scope, and the team routed those to staff instead of the model.
en.vague: I wrote a section about limitations at the end of the report.
en.exaggerated: I built an AI system that replaces human triage.
en.no_data: The limitations section was accepted and two topics were excluded.

zh.Situation: 喺政府相關機構，我做文字分類器分流公眾查詢，並要寫清楚佢嘅限制。
zh.Task: 我要用非技術讀者可以行動嘅講法，老實描述模型做唔到咩。
zh.Action: 我用上一年查詢測試，記錄每個題目嘅錯誤率，並在限制章節列明兩個剔除題目。
zh.Result: 報告把兩個題目列為範圍外，團隊改為交人手處理。
zh.vague: 我喺報告最後寫咗一節講限制。
zh.exaggerated: 我做咗個取代人手分流嘅 AI 系統。
zh.no_data: 限制章節收貨，兩個題目被剔除。
